title: Towering Gravitons in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$
summary: BPS states in holographic CFTs are usually classified into supergravitons, namely BPS fluctuations around empty AdS, and black-hole microstates, which appear above an energy threshold. In AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$, however, this picture is incomplete because of additional degrees of freedom, called singletons, associated with boundary diffeomorphisms.
